summary: Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite tables retain account-principal-bound host identity, label/kind/capabilities, current generation and last-seen time, plus sanitized per-host session snapshots. Snapshot publication replaces that host's projection atomically; snapshots omit local PTY paths and terminal output. Reservations prevent duplicate races while a host is being admitted.
lifetime: Persistent across Worker requests and Durable Object restarts; host snapshots remain available when offline and are marked stale/offline based on current relay generation and presence.
